nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set in the Owned constructor from msg.sender.
Pending owner address awaiting acceptance in the two-step ownership transfer.
_totalSupply stores the minted token amount for WhalesToken.
Mapping of token holder address to token balance.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances.
Token ticker symbol string (WHST).
Human readable token name string (WhalesToken).
Number of decimals used for token display.
Owned.transferOwnership sets the pending newOwner; guarded by onlyOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership finalizes ownership transfer when msg.sender equals newOwner.
WhalesToken constructor that mints the whole supply to the deployer.
ERC20 transfer that moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using SafeMath.
ERC20 approve that sets the allowance for a spender on behalf of msg.sender.
ERC20 transferFrom that spends an allowance and moves tokens between accounts.
Read-only getter returning the remaining allowance for a spender.
Read-only getter returning the balance of a token holder.
Returns supply minus balances of address(0) using SafeMath.sub.
Sets an allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract, an external callback.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
owner-only sweep that performs an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens to owner.
ApproveAndCallFallBack callback entry point invoked by approveAndCall.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller address used for auth and balance bookkeeping.
External call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval which transfers control to an untrusted contract while allowances are already updated.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary attacker supplied address.
SafeMath add/sub arithmetic performed on balances and allowed mappings in transfer and transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' (transfer recipient) of transfer.
Parameter 'tokens' amount in transfer.
Parameter 'spender' address in approve.
Parameter 'tokens' amount in approve.
Parameter 'from' source address in transferFrom.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' address in balanceOf.
Parameter '_newOwner' address in transferOwnership.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' in transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter 'data' bytes payload forwarded in approveAndCall.
Parameter 'tokens' amount in transferAnyERC20Token.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, storing the caller as privileged owner.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to finalize the ownership change.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller controlled address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
approveAndCall stores msg.sender as allowance owner then forwards it into the external callback.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before the arbitrary token sweep runs.
balances mapping is read and written with msg.sender as the key in transfer and transferFrom.
allowed mapping is indexed by msg.sender in approve and transferFrom.
transfer performs sub then add on balances entries, requiring overflow safe math.
transfer routes value changes through SafeMath sub/add operations.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to] with SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] with SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom relies on SafeMath add/sub for all value movement.
approve assigns the allowance value directly into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall invokes an external contract after mutating the allowance state.
External call re-enters the untrusted contract implementation of receiveApproval.
The callback receives msg.sender as the 'from' argument, propagating caller identity into external code.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external ERC20 transfer call on a caller supplied token address.
The external transfer sends the swept tokens to the stored owner address.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for tokenOwner and spender.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply using SafeMath.sub.
totalSupply reads the balances mapping at the zero address.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with the accepted newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after acceptance.
Constructor computes _totalSupply from decimals with exponentiation and assigns it.
Constructor credits the entire supply to balances[owner].
Recipient parameter to is used as the key credited in transfer.
Amount parameter tokens feeds the SafeMath sub/add in transfer.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value stored by approve.
from parameter is debited inside transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter is the lookup key returned by balanceOf.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
tokenAddress parameter is the target of the external ERC20 call.
tokenAddress parameter becomes the callee contract in the external transfer call.
data bytes parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded in the external ERC20 transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Local recipient parameter only exists to update balances inside transfer.
Amount parameter is only consumed by the SafeMath operations in transfer.
Spender parameter is only used to index the allowed mapping in approve.
Allowance amount parameter is only stored by approve.
Source address parameter is only used for balance and allowance bookkeeping in transferFrom.
Holder lookup parameter is only dereferenced by the balanceOf getter.
Pending owner parameter is only assigned to the newOwner state variable.
Arbitrary token address parameter directly determines the target of the external call.
Bytes payload parameter is only forwarded through the approveAndCall external invocation.
Sweep amount parameter is only used as the argument of the external token transfer.
